EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome Aboard Monsterindia.com - {!Account.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Patron,
We would like to take this opportunity to welcome you to the array of our esteemed customers and feel deeply humbled for the trust you have placed in our organization.
At Monsterindia.com, we pride ourselves in offering responsive, competent and scalable recruitment solutions to help you find better and leverage your company’s core asset - YOUR PEOPLE. We foster this commitment through our excellent services and support, coordinated by a steering team dedicated to your account.
For business related queries or suggestions, please get in touch with us through our helpline numbers given in the right panel.
Thank you for choosing us. Looking forward to a great business association with you.
Sincerely, Team Monster
